MG are a proud member of The Motor Ombudsman accreditation scheme and are accredited to the CTSI-approved New Car, Vehicle Sales and Service & Repair Codes of Practice, ensuring we operate to the highest standards of service and offering peace of mind for customers.

MG Motor UK Ltd is registered in England and Wales under company number: 05779958. Registered Office Address: International Headquarters, Q Gate, Low Hill Lane, Longbridge, Birmingham, B31 2BQ.

MG Motor UK Ltd (FRN - 912666) is an Appointed Representative of The Compliance Guys Ltd which is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN – 941360). We act as a credit broker not a lender. We will introduce you to a number of dealers, who also act as credit brokers. (Written Quotation available upon request). They will receive commission, however MG Motors UK Ltd will not (either a fixed fee or a fixed percentage of the amount you borrow) and this may or may not affect the total amount repayable. The lender will disclose this information before you enter into an agreement which only occurs with your express consent. The lenders they work with could pay commission at different rates and you will be notified of the amount we are paid before completion. All finance is subject to status and income. Terms and conditions apply. Applicants must be 18 years or over. They are not providing product advice and information is not impartial due to their commercial relationships with lenders, but they will make introductions in line with your needs, subject to your circumstances.

MG Motor UK Ltd are registered with the Information Commissioner's Office under registration number Z9812928.
